# Gen Rust

Generates Rust code from .t27 specs using t27c.

## Usage

```
/gen-rust <spec-file>
```

## What It Does

1. Runs `./target/release/t27c gen-rust <spec-file>`
2. Shows output or error
3. Validates generated Rust code compiles (optional)

## Example

```
/gen-rust specs/base/types.t27
```

## Output

```rust
// Generated by t27c codegen v0.1.0 (Ring-018)
// Rust codegen stub
// Source: spec types
// TODO: Implement proper Rust codegen via RustCodegen

pub enum TokenKind {
    spec = 0,
    pub_ = 1,
    ...
}
```

## Prerequisites

- t27c built (`cargo build --release -p t27c`)
- Spec file exists
- In `~/t27/` directory
